Our Story

A Legacy Carved
in Italian Stone

House of Marble was born from a single conviction: that the most beautiful material on earth deserves to be selected by hand, not by catalogue. Rooted in Ahmedabad, we bring the finest stones from Italy and beyond directly to discerning clients across India.

Every piece in our collection is personally sourced, catalogued, and matched to projects where the stone will be seen, touched, and remembered. We work with architects, interior designers, and homeowners who refuse to settle for less.

House of Marble is a proud member of the Madani Group — a diversified business conglomerate with established ventures across Granite, Textiles, Starch, and Real Estate.

How We Do It

Our Marble Slab
Manufacturing Process

From a raw block at a quarry overseas to a polished slab in your home — here is every step we take to ensure the stone you receive is perfect.

01

Global Sourcing & Import

We import premium marble blocks from the world's finest quarries across Italy, Turkey, Spain, China, Portugal, Greece and more. Every block is handpicked only after a thorough quality inspection at the source.

02

Block Preparation

Once customs clearance is completed at the port, blocks are transported to our factory. Based on client requirements, we apply a 6-side resin coating on every block — preventing cracks and breakage during the cutting process.

03

Precision Cutting

Blocks are cut using Gangsaw or Wire-saw machines with high precision. Slabs are produced in 18mm or 20mm thickness as per the order specification, ensuring consistent sizing across every lot.

04

Strengthening Process

Every slab is reinforced with a fibre net and epoxy coating on the reverse side. This treatment increases structural strength by up to 3x and ensures zero breakage during transport and installation.

05

Filling & Vacuum Treatment

Natural marble contains micro-pores that can trap dirt over time. We use vacuum epoxy filling technology — air is fully evacuated and epoxy is injected under vacuum — to seal these pores and significantly enhance both the longevity and surface shine of the slab.

06

Finishing & Display

After final polishing, every lot is displayed at our Dantali showroom. Clients are welcome to visit, walk through live stock, and personally hand-select the exact slab that will go into their home.
